title: The most eerie place in mall world.
content: A train, more like a mineshaft cart runs through a neighborhood. People live there but all the children are gone and they don’t come outside after dark. The train cart takes you into creepy tunnels. You can see broken toys scattered about and there’s different rooms. There’s a guy that tries to keep you there. It takes a long time to get out because it’s dark. Once you get out the train takes you to a weird amusement park with an orca whale. The train makes you fall in the whale water every time.
